adaptation: mgs_ssao.comp world_radius uses the screen-span unprojection principle. Perspective depth/focal simplification, vertical viewport fraction, base-radius floor, 3x cap and existing ASSAO near-camera clamp are project choices. Only radius policy is adapted; the occlusion kernel remains Godot/ASSAO. No N8AO runtime, sampling kernel or denoiser is imported.
